SceneAiCoreDescription: A holographic reactor with a rotating spherical lattice, orbital machinery and a pulsing energy core.
SceneAnimeMoonBattleDescription: Two airborne shinobi facing each other beneath a blue moon, with crossing blades and energy trails.
SceneAstralFrontierDescription: An astronaut on a rocky ridge facing a spiral galaxy, a ringed giant and a night-side Earth, with a sunrise flare, glowing atmosphere, twinkling city lights, drifting asteroids and shooting stars.
SceneAuroraBorealisDescription: Northern lights ripple above a silent mountain range and a crisp star field.
SceneCrimsonValleyDescription: A lone warrior beneath a crimson maple overlooking a sunset valley, with falling leaves, flowing waterfalls, flickering pagoda lights and drifting mist.
SceneDataTunnelDescription: An octagonal data tunnel with perspective, moving light trails and cyan / coral circuitry.
SceneDigitalRain3dDescription: Matrix code rain in three depth planes with focus blur, mirrored glyphs that mutate as they fall, a clock revealed by the rain, CRT scanlines and occasional glitches.
SceneEventHorizonDescription: A cinematic black hole with a turbulent accretion disk, gravitational lens artwork and a luminous photon ring.
SceneFireflyGroveDescription: Fireflies drift between shadowed trees and soft shafts of light in a misty grove.
SceneHiddenVillageDescription: A lantern-lit mountain village with tiled rooftops, waterfall mist and floating fireflies.
SceneLunarSilenceDescription: A lone astronaut on the lunar surface beneath a slowly turning blue Earth, with twinkling stars, shooting stars, a passing satellite and drifting moon dust.
SceneMoonlitDunesDescription: Sculpted dunes, wind-blown sand and a crescent moon in a quiet desert night.
SceneNeonRoninDescription: A hooded samurai and his cat watching a neon megacity at night, with rain and puddle ripples, flickering signs, a glowing katana, flying traffic, highway light trails, rotating targets, waterfalls, sakura petals and distant lightning.
SceneNeuralNetworkDescription: A rotating three-dimensional neural constellation with connected nodes and traveling synaptic pulses.
SceneNinjaAnimeDescription: A masked rooftop guardian, flowing scarf, crimson moon and drifting cherry blossoms.
SceneOceanDuskDescription: A low sun, slowly rolling waves and a shimmering golden reflection across the ocean.
SceneOperationsCenterDescription: A holographic operations wallpaper with a live clock, real CPU / RAM history, uptime and power status.
SceneOrangeNinjaDescription: An original orange-cloaked ninja overlooking a golden mountain valley, with wind-blown leaves.
SceneOrbitalEarthDescription: The Earth surrounded by satellites, with a sunrise on its limb, glowing atmosphere, twinkling city lights, orbiting satellites, radar pings and data links beamed down to the surface.
ScenePureCosmosDescription: A spiral galaxy and a giant ringed horizon over a mirror sea, with orbiting stars, shooting stars, a pulsing sunrise and drifting cosmic dust.
SceneRainyWindowDescription: A cinematic neon skyline through rain-streaked glass, with refracted droplets and city reflections.
SceneRobotWorkshopDescription: Three articulated robots in a quiet hangar: one keeps watch, one welds in a shower of sparks, one scans the hall, under flickering lights, drifting fog and floating dust.
SceneSakuraNightDescription: A moonlit Japanese landscape with a branching cherry canopy, mountain silhouettes, a torii and drifting petals.
SceneShinobiEnergyDescription: A standing shinobi surrounded by rotating energy seals, rising sparks and luminous ribbons.
SceneSolarSystemDescription: The Sun and the eight planets in an artistic composition, with turning planets, orbiting moons, solar prominences, a drifting asteroid belt, orbit lights and a passing comet.
SceneSpectralForgeDescription: A ray-marched liquid-metal sculpture with iridescent chrome, rotating studio reflections and a slowly deforming surface.
